events.summary: Baseline review of the project-maintained Last.fm recommendation example: package integrity, recommendation-only capability, brokered secret configuration, declared API/artwork hosts, source policy and deterministic fixture tests were checked for 0.1.0.
limitations: A user-supplied Last.fm API key and compliance with the current Last.fm API terms are required for live use.
Recommendation results are discovery metadata and are not represented as playable Last.fm media.
Runtime process isolation is not a complete operating-system sandbox.
